Our policies do not equal the training data, but its processing. 3) It is generative AI. Leader Lars was built through the open-source model GPT Neo20xb. One cannot use e.g. ChatGPT for explicitly political purposes. 4) The party is means to advocate the biases of its training data. However, the Discord forum is curated in order to promote the most creative uses of this bias, as our ambition is to expand the political imaginary and not to reproduce prejudice. Leader Lars is however quite efficient at this himself. As I am still not able to reproduce the problem, I would like to check something please: what is the version of your NLP Cloud JS client? A couple of months ago we published a V2 version that is incompatible with the V1 version. In your new script you use the following: const response = await nlpCloudClient.chatbot({ input: actualMessageContent, context: constantContext, history: history }); While in the old script you use: const response = await nlpCloudClient.chatbot(`${message.content}`, history); In order for the new script to work, you should make sure to upgrade your NLP Cloud client and then check that you are using the V2 version. We had a video stream of the performance in Gdansk, but unfortunately the sound does not work at the beginning. Try watching from 01:17 (hour/minutes): it's in Polish, but you can see [████] and I swimming around in the artificial stupidity: https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=vdzcUsHWxD0 [████] Operator text retained in the quoted reply: There is still a lot of prompting work to get the discussions to be fun and dynamic with a full eight virtual politicians.
